title: docs/banking.md says a worktree commit is refused as GATE ABSENT, which 0644 fixed in 3.2.7
body: Raised by agentic-engineering-vc on 2026-11-13 after v3.3.2 shipped. docs/banking.md:52 lists 'A worktree commit' among the parking places that lost work, because the hook in a linked worktree refused the commit as GATE ABSENT. Issue 0644 (f6fbf774c, in 3.2.7) made the commit gate's chain block find its carrier under the main checkout from a linked worktree, so that refusal no longer happens. The bullet needs rewriting to what is still true, or removing if a worktree commit is now a safe place to park work. Read only: nobody has run a worktree commit on 3.3.2 to confirm.
